values.note: 2027 on the booking site: 20/30-amp sites $37 weeknights, $40 Saturday; 50-amp sites $42 / $45 (probed 2027-05-20, 07-13 and Saturday 07-17). 2026: $35 (20/30-amp) in the DNR rates table and on the booking site, 50-amp $40. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (Grousehaven campsites on fee schedule -32465 (20/30-amp, 59 sites): 35 on 2026-10-27, 37 on 2027-05-20 and 07-13, 40 on Sat 2027-07-17; -31430 (50-amp, 17 sites): 40, 42, 42, 45) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Rifle River / Grousehaven Lake: Modern camping 20/30 AMP rate $35) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver (Grousehaven tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (17 Grousehaven campsites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', 59 '20 Amps/30 Amps'; 'Sewer Hookup=No' at every site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 75 sites on the DNR page; the booking site maps 76 Grousehaven campsites. Allowed trailer/RV length is 30 ft at 41 sites, 40 ft at 16, 50 ft at 6; 12 stop at 20 ft and one is tents/truck campers only. No pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('Rifle River Grousehaven Modern Campground': 'Number of sites: 75') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (76 Grousehaven campsites; allowed equipment max 'Trailer or RV up to N'': 20 x12, 30 x41, 40 x16, 50 x6, site 68 'Tents|Truck Camper'; no site 'Pull Through=Yes'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The park's sanitation station (two lanes, potable water) is near this campground and is closed to non-registered campers. The toilet/shower building is open for the whole reservable season.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('There is an accessible toilet and shower building'; tags 'Modern campground', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building'; 'The park's sanitation station is located near the modern campground. There is potable water available and two lanes.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Grousehaven Lake: modern toilet/shower building 'Available for all reservable season'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757; the DNR rates table gives a year-round reservation season.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('Rifle River Grousehaven Modern Campground': 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'; tag 'Winter camping or lodging') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Rifle River / Grousehaven Lake: reservation season 'Year-round' - 'Year-round') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground of Rifle River Recreation Area near Lupton: wooded sites on two loops, the Upper Loop overlooking Grousehaven Lake and the Lower Loop level with the lake; designated swim beach and easy access to the park's 14-mile multiuse trail. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + MiDNRReservations: 75 sites (confirmed; booking site maps 76), showers (confirmed) + flush toilets, potable water, sanitation station; hookups changed electric 30 -> 50 (17 sites take 50-amp), no sewer; max length changed 40 -> 50 ft (6 sites; most 30-40), no pull-throughs; fees changed 35/35 (2026) -> 37/45 (2027 booking site: 20/30-amp $37 weeknight to 50-amp $45 Saturday); reservable on MiDNRReservations / 800-447-2757 with a year-round reservation season (confirmed, derived -> manual). No statement of the campground's operating season (only a 'Winter camping or lodging' tag), so season left absent. Phone matches. Note trimmed of field restatements and the 'mostly 30-amp' / '~40 ft' figures.
